title: Luke Ross R.E.A.L. VR Framework

snapshot.public_framework_description: ReShade-based common VR framework supporting more than 40 games

licence_posture: Current framework is creator-controlled and not admitted for copying. The historical GTA V repository declares no root licence, so it is also analysis-only unless file-level permission is established.
evidence_scope: alternate-eye rendering and its later iterations
common injector plus per-game compatibility modules
seated gamepad and keyboard/mouse VR interaction
rapid repair after game, driver and upscaler updates

allowed: public creator descriptions and compatibility metadata
operator-owned observations from lawfully obtained releases
independently authored architecture, method and risk notes
forbidden: copying paywalled or withdrawn framework files
copying historical source without an applicable licence
using unauthorised mirrors or pirated copies as evidence
treating creator claims as independent headset proof

promotion_rule: Promote methods and verified behaviour, never unauthorised artefacts. Record legal and availability state as part of compatibility evidence.
